library.name: Rongmei Hymnal
library.eyebrow: A GLab digital library for worship and community singing
library.title: Rongmei songs, gathered for worship, learning and generations to come.
library.intro: Explore Rongmei gospel songbooks and selected English hymn collections in one searchable digital library. Find songs by title or number, open individual hymns, and read in a clear, adjustable format on desktop or mobile.
library.about: Rongmei Hymnal brings together digital editions of Rongmei gospel songbooks and selected English hymn collections. Each collection retains its own identity, source details, contributor credits, editorial notes and rights information. Developed by GLab Enterprise, the project aims to make these collections easier to explore and read while respecting the people and communities responsible for the original works.
